LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.3 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Fluency (inton
Topic 2.4: Reading Aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud, part of Reading 2.3 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Fluency (inton in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can you enhance your understanding of texts when reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. arrange months of the year in the correct order and read them out loud in turns,

2. read out seasonal events (圣诞 节、复活节、情人节、 放 假、 开学) as peers identify the appropriate month associated with it,

3. work jointly to read out rhymes on months of the year for feedback,

4. read out simple texts related to seasonal events at different months of the year incorporating strategic pauses to emphasise key points,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. arrange months of the year in the correct order and read them out loud in turns,
2. read out seasonal events (圣诞 节、复活节、情人节、 放 假、 开学) as peers identify the appropriate month associated with it,
3. work jointly to read out rhymes on months of the year for feedback,
4. read out simple texts related to seasonal events at different months of the year incorporating strategic pauses to emphasise key points,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: The learner develops clarity of communication when they reflect and identify areas of improvement when reading

aloud.

Values:
Social justice: The learner advocates for harmonious relationships in the classroom as they work with peers to read out rhymes

on months of the year.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Healthy intra and inter personal relationships: This is enhanced when the learner teams up with peers to read and extract key

points from a text, and then generates questions from it.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner can relate the concept of differentiated activities for months of the year and seasons to their learning in Agriculture

and Nutrition.
